title: True or False
concept: Bool is the simplest type: it can only be true or false.
why: Programs make decisions based on whether something is true or false. Bool is the foundation of all logic.
syntax_ref:
let name: Bool = true;
let name: Bool = false;
tips: `true` and `false` are always lowercase in XIOM
Bool variables often start with `is_`, `has_`, or `can_`
A Bool uses very little memory — just one bit!
Bools become powerful when combined with `if` statements (coming soon)
common_mistakes: Capitalizing `True` or `False` — they must be lowercase
Putting `true` or `false` in quotes — they're values, not strings
Using `1` or `0` instead of `true` or `false` — XIOM keeps them distinct
